title: Oracle is Expanding the Accelerator Options in OCI for Enterprises
gist: At Oracle AI World 2026, Oracle added Google TPUs, Cerebras and SambaNova SN50 options to OCI alongside Nvidia and AMD, launched a Deep Trust AI Architecture, and expanded OpenAI and agentic Fusion offerings, against a backdrop of $664B in RPO and capex possibly above $90B.

themes.theme: Financial backdrop and AI bubble worry

insights.claim: Oracle's sales rose from $57.4 billion in fiscal 2025 to $67.4 billion in fiscal 2026, and OCI revenue hit $7.4 billion in Q1 FY2027, up 121 percent year over year.
insights.speaker: Jeff Burt
insights.so_what: OCI growth validates AI infrastructure demand for Oracle.

insights.claim: Oracle's remaining performance obligations reached $664 billion, up $209 billion year over year.
insights.speaker: Jeff Burt
insights.so_what: Backlog concentration and conversion to revenue is the key Oracle credit/equity watch item.

insights.claim: Oracle's capex was $55.7 billion in FY2026 and could exceed $90 billion this fiscal year amid growing public resistance to datacenter buildouts, making it a cautionary tale for AI-bubble concerns.
insights.speaker: Jeff Burt
insights.so_what: Funding burden and political resistance are the main downside risks to the Oracle AI buildout.
insights.quote: often pointed to as a cautionary tale

insights.claim: Google TPUs will be available on OCI next year, the first time Google's AI chips are offered in a hyperscale environment other than Google's own.
insights.speaker: Jeff Burt
insights.so_what: Weakens the Nvidia-only framing and widens TPU's addressable market.

insights.claim: Oracle will deploy Cerebras fast-inference hardware, including the CS-4 built on three Wafer Scale Engine 3 Turbo chips that Cerebras claims offer up to 30 times the tokens-per-second-per-user of GPUs, into OCI in 2027.
insights.speaker: Jeff Burt
insights.so_what: Cerebras gains hyperscale distribution; speed claim is vendor-stated.

insights.claim: Oracle will offer SambaNova's SN50 RDUs, designed to work with GPUs handling prefill while RDUs handle decode.
insights.speaker: Jeff Burt
insights.so_what: Disaggregated prefill/decode across heterogeneous silicon is an emerging inference architecture.

insights.claim: Oracle's OCI product head says Oracle partners deeply with best-in-breed vendors including Nvidia and AMD and does not want to dictate or cut off customer options.
insights.speaker: Jeff Burt
insights.so_what: Oracle positions as a neutral multi-silicon cloud, a differentiator versus hyperscalers with in-house chips.
insights.quote: We don't want to put ourselves in a position where we're dictating any of that stuff or trying to cut off any options for those customers.

insights.claim: Oracle unveiled a Deep Trust AI Architecture embedded in its AI Database, Autonomous AI Database and APEX to protect data, enforce business rules, ensure accurate answers and control AI interaction with enterprise environments.
insights.speaker: Jeff Burt
insights.so_what: Oracle is betting data-layer security is its enterprise AI moat.
insights.quote: build trust into the architecture from the start, instead of trying to bolt it on later

insights.claim: Oracle is expanding its OpenAI partnership, linking OpenAI models, ChatGPT and Codex with Oracle applications, data and cloud infrastructure, including ChatGPT plug-ins in Oracle AI Workspace.
insights.speaker: Jeff Burt
insights.so_what: Deepens Oracle's dependency and alignment with OpenAI.

insights.claim: Oracle unveiled 25 new agentic applications across Fusion suites powered by Fusion Claw, plus Fusion Companion and a public Git repository, the Fusion Setup and Configuration Registry, to turn best practices into reusable agent skills.
insights.speaker: Jeff Burt
insights.so_what: Agentic ERP/HCM features are the monetization path for Oracle apps.

insights.claim: Co-CEO Mike Sicilia argues AI should let users simply state what they want while the system understands the business and works it out, reducing the need to navigate applications.
insights.speaker: Jeff Burt
insights.so_what: Implies intent-driven interfaces displacing traditional application UI.
insights.quote: you simply tell the system what you’d like to accomplish
